examples.title: Settings row
examples.description: Compose a labelled setting control with guidance.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { Input } from '@lostgradient/cinder';
  import { SettingRow } from '@lostgradient/cinder';
</script>

<SettingRow id="display-name" label="Display name" description="Shown to collaborators.">
  {#snippet control()}
    <Input id="display-name" value="" placeholder="Ada Lovelace">
      {#snippet leading()}{/snippet}
      {#snippet trailing()}{/snippet}
    </Input>
  {/snippet}
</SettingRow>

examples.title: Save status, failure and lock
examples.description: A setting saves when you leave the field and says where it has got to on its own row: Saving, Saved, Applies after restart, Saved waiting for a restart. An invalid value fails at its field and nothing is saved; a failed save keeps the value and offers a quiet Retry; a locked setting says why with a lock glyph. Below a container width the control stacks under the label.
